AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. This role leads a cross-functional managed services team and vendor partners to ensure availability, performance, security, compliance, and cost optimization of data center and hybrid cloud services, aligned to ITIL practices and business SLAs.

**Your Role**
-------------

**Service Delivery & Operations**

* Own end-to-end delivery of managed infrastructure services across:
    
  o Wintel (Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux as applicable, virtualization platforms)
    
  o Citrix (Virtual Apps & Desktops, Netscaler/ADC if applicable)
    
  o Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP operations, landing zones, governance, FinOps collaboration)
    
  o Database (SQL Server/Oracle/PostgreSQL/MySQL ops; patching, performance, HA/DR)
    
  o Backup & Recovery (Veeam/Commvault/NetBackup, retention, immutability, restore testing)
    
  o Storage (SAN/NAS/Object; performance, capacity, replication)
* Ensure services meet or exceed SLA/SLO/OLA commitments (availability, response, restore times, performance).
* Drive incident, problem, change, and request management with strong ITIL discipline.
* Lead Major Incident Management (MIM): facilitate bridge calls, coordinate teams, ensure timely comms, deliver post-incident reviews.

**Security, Risk, and Compliance**

* Partner with InfoSec and Risk to enforce hardening standards, vulnerability remediation SLAs, identity/access controls, logging/monitoring, and secure configurations.
* Ensure backup and recovery strategies align with ransomware resilience practices (immutable backups, offline copies where needed, tested restores).

* Own infrastructure change pipeline; ensure changes are risk-assessed, tested, scheduled, and communicated.

* Ensure strong coordination across dependent teams and business units to minimize downtime and avoid conflicts.

* Manage managed service providers (MSPs) and OEMs: contract adherence, SLA performance, root cause follow-through, escalation handling.
* Set clear expectations, provide performance feedback, and ensure coverage models support 24x7 operations (as required).

* Proven success in SLA management, operational governance, and continuous improvement.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring and ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Splunk).

* Certifications (one or more): ITIL Foundation/Managing Professional, Microsoft (Azure/Windows), Citrix, VMware, AWS, Cisco/NetApp/EMC, Veeam/Commvault, SQL Server/Oracle, Security

  o Zero Trust / identity-centric controls, PAM, and audit readiness
    
  o Cloud governance, landing zones, policy-as-code, and cost management (FinOps)

* Customer-focused service mindset with strong stakeholder management
* Analytical problem-solving; drives root cause elimination

.

Transform the backbone of digital infrastructure by leading a dynamic team that builds and maintains the critical networks powering global technology. In this role, you'll drive operational excellence, optimize data center deployment strategies, and create seamless connectivity solutions that support Amazon's massive technological ecosystem.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the clouds running. Delivering capacity to existing Data Centers

Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors  
Liaising with internal teams & management groups

Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes  
Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.  
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.  
  
Essential Requirements  
Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed  
Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.  
US citizenship required

* 2+ years of TCP/IP networking, network cabling, fiber, optic types, and test equipment experience

We are searching for a Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering to guide, mentor, and scale the engineering squad responsible for our platform stability. At Questrade, we don’t just watch dashboards, we build the intelligence that anticipates failures. Our mission is to achieve absolute reliability and resilience, ensuring our high-frequency trading platforms remain unshakable under the pressure of global markets.
  
  
In this role, you will lead a team of talented SREs who don't just fix problems in Production, they engineer out their possibilities. You are a player-coach and an evangelist for Site/System Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles who views manual toil as a bug to be automated. Most importantly, you will set the technical vision for how your team leverages Machine Learning (ML) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to transform reactive operations into predictive, self-healing systems.
  
  
**The mandate**
**Your Domain: Leading at the Intersection of SRE & AI**
As The Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering Within The Questrade Experience Platform Engineering Group, You Will Balance Hands-on Architectural Leadership With People Management. Your Playground Involves
  
  

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, coach, and grow a squad of System Reliability Engineers. Conduct 1:1s, drive career development, foster a culture of psychological safety and high accountability, and manage capacity across sprint work and on-call rotations.
* SRE Strategy & Governance: Champion SRE best practices across the engineering organization. Guide your team and partner squads in defining and managing SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budgets to balance the velocity of innovation with the necessity of stability.
* AI-Powered Operational Vision: Spearhead the roadmap for applying ML models to "Smart Alerting" and anomaly detection, guiding your team to move beyond static thresholds toward systems that understand patterns and mitigate outages before they happen.
* Autonomous Resilience: Oversee the architecture and implementation of self-healing workflows. Whether it's auto-scaling GKE clusters or building LLM-assisted incident response playbooks, you are steering the development of the "autopilot" for our production environments.
* Cloud Native Excellence: Set the architectural standard for orchestrating highly available systems using GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Terraform, and Helm, ensuring our infrastructure is declarative, versioned, and resilient.
* Executive Incident Command: Serve as an escalation point and Principal Incident Commander during critical, high-severity incidents. Lead cross-functional "War Rooms" with Engineering, DBAs, Network teams, and Executive stakeholders, and champion a blameless post-mortem culture to drive long-term system improvement.
* Domain Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge of trading systems is desired but not required.

**You’re ready for this mandate if you have the following qualifications**
You are a high-level problem solver and inspiring technical leader who bridges the gap between deep systems knowledge, software engineering, and people management.
  
  
**Leadership & Strategic Execution**

* Proven Team Leadership: 7+ years of experience in System Reliability or DevOps engineering, including 2+ years in a formal Team Lead, Tech Lead, or Engineering Management capacity mentoring and managing engineers.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to align engineering squads, product owners, and executive leadership around reliability roadmaps, error budgets, and architectural investments.
* Blameless Culture Builder: You foster an environment where engineers feel safe to experiment, own mistakes, and learn rapidly through rigorous, blameless post-mortems.

**Your Technical Arsenal**

* Automating Support: Strong software engineering background with mastery of Python, C#, and Bash to guide code reviews and build scalable automation frameworks.
* Cloud & Orchestration: Mastery of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE); advanced proficiency in container orchestration and IaC using Kubernetes (kubectl), Helm, and Terraform.
* Modern Observability: Advanced capability in Splunk (Administration/Querying) and Datadog, with experience architecting AI-enhanced observability and dashboards.
* System Versatility: Strong experience with Linux systems and a solid understanding of Windows IIS server, enabling you to guide troubleshooting across a diverse application stack.
* Database & Network Mastery: Strong grasp of MS SQL/MySQL and a deep understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, UDP).

**Mastery of the Incident Lifecycle**

* Incident Command & Escalation: Act as the senior lead during high-severity events, coordinating between Engineering, DBA, Network, and Executive stakeholders to drive rapid service restoration and clear communication.
* The "Resolution First" Mindset: You possess the technical intuition to quickly distinguish between symptoms and root causes under pressure, guiding your team in applying immediate remediation followed by systemic fixes to eliminate technical debt.
* Automated Incident Response: You champion the use of Python, Bash, and AI-driven tools to automate common remediation patterns (e.g., auto-restarting stalled pods, triggering failovers, or clearing cache bottlenecks).

Reporting to the Senior Manager, IT/OT Infrastructure and Cybersecurity, you will be part of a team developing advanced OT and energy solutions for large business and institutional customers, including electric vehicle charging, battery energy storage systems (BESS), solar PV, microgrids, and distributed energy resources. Your work will directly support the design, deployment, cybersecurity, operation, and lifecycle management of mission-critical operational technology infrastructure that enables the transition to a clean energy economy.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on OT infrastructure practitioner with deep networking expertise and strong practical capability across telecommunications, server infrastructure, cybersecurity implementation, commissioning, and technical documentation. You understand an OT environment end to end, from physical telecommunications and network topology through servers, applications, remote access, and security controls. You translate requirements from OT Cybersecurity, Systems Integration, Engineering, and Operations into reliable, secure, maintainable infrastructure.

This is not a cybersecurity governance or design-only role. You will move between architecture, implementation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and operational support, and own technical problems through to resolution, while helping establish scalable, secure-by-design OT standards across PowerON’s growing fleet electrification portfolio.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**OT Network & Infrastructure Architecture**

* Design, build, and support secure, scalable, and highly available OT network architectures for electrification infrastructure projects including EV charging depots, BESS, DERs, and microgrids.
* Own OT network topology, segmentation, VLANs, routing, switching, and network services.
* Set up and configure servers, virtualization, and supporting infrastructure for OT applications and services, including patching, lifecycle planning, backup configuration, and recoverability.
* Understand and map communication and data flows between server hosts and applications.
* Design and implement secure remote-access architecture.
* Develop network architectures supporting secure integration between OT systems, cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems, and third-party vendor environments.
* Implement resilient industrial network topologies including PRP, HSR, redundant ring architectures, and industrial failover strategies.
* Translate logical architecture into functioning, supportable infrastructure.
* Collaborate with systems integrators, software vendors, consultants, utilities, and engineers of record to ensure alignment between OT network architecture and overall project objectives.
* Evaluate and select OT infrastructure technologies including firewalls, switches, cellular gateways, servers, VPN/remote access technologies, and industrial communications equipment.

**Telecommunications & Site Connectivity**

* Understand and work with the physical network and telecommunications topology supporting operational sites and systems.
* Assess site connectivity and infrastructure dependencies, and how physical connectivity supports the logical OT network architecture.
* Plan for telecommunications requirements during deployment and commissioning.
* Troubleshoot connectivity across physical and logical layers to protect OT system availability and performance.

**OT Cybersecurity Implementation**

* Work with OT cybersecurity leadership to translate cybersecurity architecture and requirements into implemented technical controls.
* Implement network segmentation, security zones, firewall policies, access control rules, and data flow matrices.
* Implement secure remote access for employees, contractors, and vendors, including administration of VPN and privileged access management (PAM) solutions and identity and privileged-access controls for OT systems.
* Harden systems and apply secure configuration across OT infrastructure.
* Carry out patch and vulnerability remediation and implement backup and recovery controls.
* Apply secure-by-design principles aligned with ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and Zero Trust.
* Contribute to cybersecurity risk assessments and technical reviews, and carry out the resulting remediation.

**Project Delivery, Commissioning & Technical Oversight**

* Support projects across the full lifecycle including requirements development, detailed design review, procurement support, FAT/SAT testing, commissioning, and operational turnover.
* Lead infrastructure commissioning and operational readiness, and support the transition from project delivery into operations.
* Own technical problems through to resolution: identify deficiencies, perform root-cause analysis, and establish a practical path to green.
* Coordinate remediation across SCADA, electrical, cybersecurity, and operations teams, and track technical issues through closure.
* Ensure final deliverables align with approved requirements, standards, and operational expectations.

**Operations & Lifecycle Support**

* Provide operational support for deployed OT infrastructure across active electrification sites.
* Support maintenance and lifecycle management of industrial firewalls, managed switches, OT servers, virtualization infrastructure, remote access platforms, and industrial communications devices.
* Support system uptime, reliability, and operational continuity through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and coordination with operations teams, contractors and vendors.
* Participate in on-site activities as required to support commissioning, troubleshooting, incident response, and operational support.

**Documentation & Standards**

* Create and maintain logical and physical network diagrams, infrastructure architecture, data-flow documentation, and as-built documentation that accurately reflect the implemented OT environment.
* Maintain operational OT network documentation including IP address schemas, AD roles and permissions, firewall rule matrices, VLAN segmentation documentation, and remote access inventories.
* Develop network and infrastructure requirements and technical design documentation issued to vendors, contractors, and engineering consultants.
* Establish configuration and implementation standards that scale across PowerON’s portfolio.
* Treat documentation as part of engineering delivery, not an afterthought.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* University degree in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting OT networks, industrial infrastructure, SCADA systems, or critical infrastructure environments.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in OT network topology, VLANs, routing and switching, NAT, VPN technologies, firewall policy management, network segmentation, and redundant network architectures.
* Hands-on experience setting up, configuring, patching, and backing up server and virtualization infrastructure in OT environments, including Windows Server.
* Strong working knowledge of physical telecommunications infrastructure and site connectivity, and how they affect OT system availability and performance.
* Experience implementing security controls on industrial networking and security technologies such as Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco Industrial Ethernet, and RuggedCom, including system hardening and vulnerability remediation.
* Familiarity with industrial protocols including Modbus TCP/IP, DNP3, IEC 61850, OPC UA, MQTT, and SCADA/EMS systems.
* Familiarity with ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82.
* Experience supporting cloud-connected OT architectures and hybrid IT/OT environments.
* Demonstrated experience commissioning infrastructure, resolving deficiencies, and transitioning projects into operations.
* Experience producing and maintaining as-built documentation, network drawings, and data-flow documentation, and reviewing vendor deliverables.
* Strong troubleshooting and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of driving issues to resolution, not just identifying them.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical risk and remediation paths to engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams, vendors, and partners.

Title: Technical Program Manager-Data Center
Description:
**About the Role:**

The Technical Program Manager administers the qualification and validation of new products, and of retrofits and engineering changes to existing parts, for use in large-scale data center environments. The program spans inside plant (ISP) and outside plant (OSP) optical fiber cable, connectivity, and pathway products from candidate identification through validated, released configuration. The position owns the technical content of the program: product selection and evaluation criteria, test methodology, acceptance limits, measurement integrity, and the qualification record that supports product approval and release. The Technical Program Manager serves as the technical interface between design engineering, construction and installation crews, component manufacturers, and test equipment suppliers, and is accountable for validated, documented, and field-reproducible connectivity products on schedule.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Validation Program Planning and Execution:** Develop and own integrated validation program plans covering both new product introduction and retrofits or engineering changes to existing parts — qualification sequence, entry and exit criteria, material and laboratory dependencies, and decision gates — holding the critical path and driving programs to documented closure.
* **Inside Plant and Outside Plant Infrastructure:** Manage ISP structured cabling across backbone and horizontal distribution, riser and plenum pathways, main and intermediate distribution frames (MDF/IDF), cabinet and rack-mounted patch fields, fiber distribution frames, splice and termination enclosures, cassette-based modular patching, cable tray, basket and innerduct pathway, and firestopping and pathway segregation; and OSP placement across duct bank and conduit, microduct and air-blown fiber, maintenance holes and handholes, aerial and direct-buried routes, building entrance facilities and points of entry (MPOE), transition splice points, armored and dielectric constructions, and environmental and ingress protection at the ISP/OSP demarcation.
* **Fiber Cable, Connectivity, and Termination Scope:** Qualify single-mode (OS2, 9/125 µm) and multimode cable across the full range of standard counts in general industry use, from 24-fiber distribution cable through 3456-fiber high-count backbone, in loose tube, central core, ribbon, rollable ribbon, and 200/250 µm coating designs, evaluating diameter, bend radius, pulling tension, duct fill, and mid-span access against pathway and installation constraints. Own connectivity across LC and LC duplex, MTP/MPO single-row and dual-row arrays (8, 12, 16, and 24 fiber), and very-high-density MMC arrays (16 and 24 fiber), including pinned (male) and unpinned (female) configurations, UPC and APC endface geometries, gender and key orientation, and polarity schemes spanning TIA-568 Method A, B, and C and the conventions applicable to multi-row arrays. Define and validate patch panel, cassette, adapter plate, and shelf configurations for port density, fiber management, bend radius protection, slack storage, labeling access, and serviceability, and evaluate breakout, fanout, harness, trunk, and pigtail assemblies against port mapping and channel performance requirements.
* **Test, Measurement, and Acceptance:** Establish and govern optical test programs — Tier 1 optical loss test set (OLTS) insertion loss and return loss certification, Tier 2 OTDR characterization, bidirectional testing, length and continuity verification, polarity and fitment verification, and endface inspection and cleaning to recognized criteria such as IEC 61300-3-35 — controlling test reference cord (TRC) grade, referencing method, and calibration state so results are repeatable and defensible. Reconcile measured channel performance against design acceptance criteria and transceiver link specifications, and drive corrective action where acceptance limits are not met.
* **Supplier Qualification and Test Equipment Capability:** Lead technical qualification of cable, connectivity, and pathway manufacturers through sample submission, first-article inspection, mechanical and optical evaluation, failure analysis, root cause determination, and corrective action closure, maintaining a defensible qualification record and a clear statement of remaining gaps per supplier. Evaluate, select, and introduce fiber test and inspection platforms end to end, covering technical evaluation against requirements, procurement support, asset control and inventory, calibration and reference cord management, operator training, and fleet distribution to regional field crews.
* **Documentation and Standards:** Produce and sustain installation work instructions, test procedures, golden samples, first-of-kind build documentation, labeling and administration schemes, and as-built records, maintaining them so methods are applied consistently by field crews and subcontractors without procedural drift.
* **Program Governance and Risk Management:** Maintain accurate program status, ownership, target dates, and documented reasons for schedule movement, and produce recurring technical status reporting for client and internal leadership, surfacing aging, blocked, and unassigned work rather than allowing it to persist. Identify technical, schedule, supply chain, and capability risks in advance, quantify impact, drive mitigation to a named owner and committed date, and escalate with a recommendation.
* **Safety and Regulatory Compliance:** Champion a zero-injury culture in laboratory and field environments, ensuring personnel and subcontractors understand and apply laser safety, confined space, excavation, aerial work, and fiber handling requirements, and that work complies with OSHA and other applicable regulations and site access requirements.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Knowledge and use of basic telecom hand tools.
* Must understand customer service.
* Cleared understanding of job safety requirements.
* Should be familiar on wiring schemes and wiring test.
* Reports to Operations Manager and take daily directions from Technician, Technician II, Lead Technicians, Senior Technicians and Advance Senior Technicians.
* Perform 4 pair continuity testing
* Pull all types of low voltage cable including copper telecom cable
* Performing all types of copper field terminations
* Install ladder racking and seismic bracing
* Patch network equipment
* Read and Understand Port Maps/Matrices
* Read and understand job floor plan and TC drawings
* Should understand and be capable in performing field terminations and labeling.
* Install Copper and Fiber Cabling and labeling
* Affixing Labels to cabling and Power Cords
* Affix bar coding to equipment
* Affix free printed label
* Cut and install threaded rod
* Cut and install Uni-strut
* Cut and install fiber trough
* Create/test Bonding whips, straps, and connections
* Understand the basics of "FIM" and operate scanner

Prime Video is searching for a Senior Incident Manager. This senior-level incident management role is responsible for leading the incident response function for Prime Video's video-on-demand platform. The key responsibilities include:

The ideal candidate has 10+ years of incident management experience, including incident response for a large-scale enterprise. They have strong technical, analytical, and communication skills to liaise effectively with engineering and executive teams.

Define the strategy for the evolution of Prime Video’s response to video on demand impacting incidents. Establish the operating model for how the new, dedicated function will operate within Prime Video.

Increase the scope of team-maintained dashboards. Influence the roadmaps of the engineering teams developing incident management, observability and triage tooling.
  
  
Lead the Incident Response function. Ensure the globally distributed team is ready to respond 24x7. Actively mentor and develop the junior Incident Managers.
  
  
Own operational metrics. Set clear, measurable, goals for the quality of incident response and establish mechanisms to drive continual improvement. Foster a culture of continuous improvement through mentoring, feedback and metrics
  
  
Lead incident response for high severity incidents. Decompose complex incidents into work streams that can be managed by multiple incident responders in parallel. Manage communications and be the single point of contact for executive leaders

Title: Director, IT Service Management

CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Title: Executive Director, IT Infrastructure & Network Engineering
Description:
Life changing therapies. Global impact. Bridge to thousands of biopharma companies and their patients.

**We are PCI.**

Our investment is in People who make an impact, drive progress and create a better tomorrow. Our strategy includes building teams across our global network to pioneer and shape the future of PCI.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
=========================================

**1. Infrastructure & Network Strategy**
----------------------------------------

* Develop and execute a multi-year global infrastructure and network strategy aligned with PCI's business strategy, manufacturing expansion, acquisition activity, digital transformation, cybersecurity requirements and customer commitments.
* Define target-state architectures and investment roadmaps spanning on-premise, hosted, hybrid-cloud and cloud-native platforms.
* Establish enterprise standards and lifecycle strategies for compute, storage, virtualization, cloud, network, wireless, SD-WAN and supporting infrastructure technologies.
* Identify technical debt, capacity constraints, obsolescence and architectural risks and incorporate remediation into disciplined multi-year roadmaps.
* Serve as the CIO's senior advisor regarding infrastructure strategy, investments, emerging technologies, engineering priorities, resiliency and technology risk.

**2. Global Network Engineering & Connectivity**
------------------------------------------------

* Own the architecture, engineering and lifecycle management of PCI's global WAN, SD-WAN, LAN, wireless, internet, remote-access and telecommunications environment.
* Ensure highly available connectivity across geographically distributed business locations and facility connections supporting operations in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain, Germany and Australia.
* Establish engineering standards for site connectivity, network segmentation, redundancy, observability, capacity, performance and resilient communications.
* Develop and maintain network reference architectures and standardized approaches for new facilities, manufacturing expansions and acquired locations.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and Operational Technology teams to appropriately segment and protect enterprise, manufacturing and OT environments.
* Establish appropriate resiliency for business-critical facilities, including carrier diversity, failover strategies and tested recovery procedures.

**3. Infrastructure, Cloud & Platform Engineering**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead architecture and engineering for enterprise compute, storage, virtualization, backup, recovery, infrastructure hosting and associated platform technologies.
* Establish a deliberate hybrid infrastructure strategy determining when workloads should operate in on-premise, hosted, SaaS, IaaS or PaaS environments.
* Lead cloud infrastructure architecture, governance and engineering with particular emphasis on the secure integration of SaaS and other cloud-native services.
* Establish cloud architecture standards, landing-zone principles, connectivity patterns, operational practices, cost governance and lifecycle management.
* Drive simplification and standardization of infrastructure platforms across PCI's global estate.
* Establish architecture review and technical design disciplines that prevent unnecessary technology proliferation.

**4. Infrastructure Solution Delivery**
---------------------------------------

* Maintain end-to-end executive accountability for infrastructure and network solution delivery, from requirements and architecture through engineering, implementation, transition and operational acceptance.
* Establish a governed pipeline for infrastructure demand and maintain visibility into priorities, committed delivery dates, resource capacity, dependencies and risks.
* Provide infrastructure engineering leadership for site expansions, manufacturing projects, acquisitions, application implementations, ERP initiatives and digital transformation programs.
* Require appropriate architecture, engineering documentation, cybersecurity review, testing, change control, operational readiness and support-transition activities before production implementation.
* Establish measurable delivery commitments and hold teams and partners accountable for execution against approved scope, schedule and budget.
* Ensure projects deliver supportable, secure, resilient and standardized enterprise solutions.

**5. Pharmaceutical CDMO / GxP Infrastructure**
-----------------------------------------------

* Ensure infrastructure supporting GxP-regulated applications and manufacturing processes remains in a demonstrable state of control throughout its lifecycle.
* Partner closely with Quality, Validation, Regulatory, Cybersecurity, Engineering and business teams when designing or modifying infrastructure supporting regulated computerized systems.
* Ensure infrastructure changes, upgrades and migrations affecting regulated applications follow PCI change-control, qualification, documentation and validation requirements.
* Maintain infrastructure capabilities supporting data integrity, system availability, auditability, backup and recovery, controlled access and business continuity for GxP environments.
* Develop infrastructure architectures appropriate for highly regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing and packaging environments where system interruption may affect manufacturing operations, product release, customer commitments or regulatory compliance.
* Support customer audits, internal audits and regulatory inspections where infrastructure architecture, hosting, access, recovery or control evidence is required.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge of cGMP, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and ISPE GAMP 5 principles applicable to underlying technology platforms.

**6. Reliability, Resilience & Business Continuity**
----------------------------------------------------

* Establish engineering standards for infrastructure availability, redundancy, capacity, recovery and fault tolerance based upon business criticality.
* Partner with IT Operations to establish measurable availability, capacity and performance objectives for infrastructure services.
* Ensure disaster recovery architectures align with business-defined recovery objectives.
* Establish regular testing of infrastructure recovery, network failover, backup restoration and critical-site resiliency.
* Use incident, problem and performance data to identify systemic weaknesses requiring architectural or engineering remediation.
* Maintain infrastructure capabilities that support PCI's manufacturing, packaging, warehousing, laboratory and customer operations across global time zones.

**7. Cybersecurity Partnership**
--------------------------------

* Partner with the CISO and Cybersecurity organization to ensure infrastructure and network architectures implement PCI cybersecurity standards and required controls in a timely manner.
* Embed security requirements into architecture and engineering practices rather than relying solely on post-implementation remediation.
* Drive infrastructure hardening, vulnerability remediation, network segmentation and secure architecture improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure engineering supports cyber incident response, containment and recovery requirements.
* Maintain clear accountability boundaries between Cybersecurity governance and control requirements and Infrastructure implementation and execution.

**8. Strategic Growth, New Sites & Acquisition Integration**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Lead infrastructure technical due diligence and integration planning associated with acquisitions.
* Develop repeatable infrastructure and network integration playbooks covering connectivity, cloud, hosting, identity dependencies, communications, cybersecurity, business continuity and technology lifecycle.
* Provide architecture and engineering support for new facilities, building expansions and manufacturing capacity additions.
* Standardize acquired and newly constructed environments toward PCI enterprise architecture while balancing business continuity, regulatory constraints, cost and integration timing.
* Develop scalable reference architectures enabling PCI to add facilities and manufacturing capacity without redesigning infrastructure for each location.

**9. Leadership & Organizational Development**
----------------------------------------------

* Lead an organization of infrastructure and network professionals.
* Establish clear accountability across infrastructure and platform engineering, network engineering and infrastructure solution delivery.
* Build strong engineering leadership beneath the Executive Director and avoid creating an organization overly dependent upon the executive for tactical decisions.
* Develop technical career paths, succession plans and capability-development programs for engineers and managers.
* Establish a high-accountability culture emphasizing technical excellence, disciplined execution, collaboration, transparency and customer impact.
* Develop global teams capable of operating effectively across the US, Europe and Australia.

**10. Financial, Vendor & Technology Lifecycle Management**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Own infrastructure and network operating and capital planning, forecasting and investment governance.
* Establish lifecycle plans for major infrastructure assets and services to prevent unplanned end-of-life and obsolescence risks.
* Govern strategic technology providers, telecommunications carriers, cloud providers, hosting partners, hardware and software vendors and managed-service providers.
* Lead significant infrastructure sourcing decisions and contract and service-performance reviews.
* Balance service resilience, technology modernization, cybersecurity risk and cost optimization when developing investment recommendations.
* Establish financial and operational measures demonstrating both the cost and business value of infrastructure services.

**Success Measures**
====================

* Improved visibility into infrastructure plans, commitments, risks, capacity and delivery status.
* Consistent delivery of infrastructure and network solutions against approved scope, schedule and budget.
* Increased service resilience and reduced frequency and business impact of recurring infrastructure incidents.
* Measurable progress in infrastructure standardization, lifecycle management and technical-debt reduction.
* Improved disaster recovery, network failover and critical-site resiliency readiness.
* Infrastructure supporting GxP systems maintained in a demonstrable state of control.
* Successful integration of acquisitions, new facilities and manufacturing expansions into PCI's global technology environment.
* Strong organizational capability, succession depth and engagement across global engineering teams.
* Effective alignment with Cybersecurity, Quality, Validation, Operations, ERP, Data and business leadership.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent senior-level experience.
* 15+ years of progressive infrastructure and network technology experience, including significant senior leadership responsibility in a complex global enterprise.
* 7+ years leading infrastructure, network, cloud or engineering organizations.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams of comparable scale across multiple countries and time zones.
* Significant experience architecting and operating hybrid technology environments spanning on-premise, hosted and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking including WAN, LAN, SD-WAN, wireless, network segmentation, internet connectivity, redundancy and network observability.
* Demonstrated cloud experience, preferably with Microsoft Azure.
* Experience managing infrastructure supporting manufacturing or other highly available operational environments.
* Demonstrated success leading major infrastructure modernization and solution-delivery programs.
* Experience managing substantial technology budgets, capital investments, vendors and strategic service providers.
* Strong executive communication capabilities with the ability to translate highly technical subjects into business risk, investment choices and operational implications.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

* Previous pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life-sciences or CDMO experience.
* Demonstrated experience supporting GxP and cGMP-regulated computerized systems.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure requirements associated with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and GAMP 5.
* Experience supporting pharmaceutical manufacturing, packaging, laboratories, warehouses and validated computerized systems.
* Experience integrating acquired businesses or newly constructed manufacturing facilities into an enterprise infrastructure environment.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure, Cisco networking, ITIL, TOGAF, PMP or equivalent technical and leadership credentials.

**Leadership Profile**
======================

The successful Executive Director will be:

* An executive who understands engineering, not simply an infrastructure administrator.
* An execution leader who converts strategy into accountable roadmaps and delivered solutions.
* Comfortable moving between executive investment decisions and detailed technical discussions with engineers.
* Highly disciplined around commitments, architecture standards, technical debt and lifecycle management.
* Metrics-driven and transparent about service health, risks, delivery commitments and investment needs.
* Calm and decisive during business-critical incidents.
* Able to standardize a global environment without becoming bureaucratic.
* Experienced working with Quality and Cybersecurity as peer control functions.
* Effective leading culturally and geographically distributed teams.
* Focused on business outcomes, resiliency and delivery rather than technology for technology's sake.

**Company and Regulatory Expectations**
=======================================

* Demonstrate substantial knowledge and business acumen regarding the pharmaceutical services and CDMO industry and PCI business processes.
* Complete all duties in compliance with company policies, SOPs, safety rules and applicable federal, state, local and international requirements, including FDA and cGMP expectations.
* Adhere to all applicable PCI, cGMP and GxP policies, procedures and rules.
* Travel internationally and work outside normal business hours as necessary to support global operations, major implementations and critical incidents.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization
Description:
**Job Description**

  

**Vacancy Status:** This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

**AI Disclosure:** As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

  

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

  

The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on technology leader with a track record of operating and modernizing complex enterprise data environments. They can lead multidisciplinary teams across data engineering, business analysis, data quality, and governance; align business and technology stakeholders around a clear modernization roadmap; and deliver large-scale migration while protecting the reliability of existing services. They understand how to build trusted, well-governed data foundations that enable enterprise-wide analytics and AI adoption.

  

**The Role**
------------

As the Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization, you will lead the team responsible for the day-to-day health and continued operation of the existing enterprise data warehouse, as well as its modernization and migration to a cloud-based environment. You will set direction, establish delivery and operational priorities, and ensure the platform evolves to meet the needs of GM Canada and the wider enterprise.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team comprising three Data Engineering, Cloud Migration & Platforms Engineers; one Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration; one Data Validation & Data Quality Analyst, Enterprise Data; and one Data Governance Analyst. You will bring these capabilities together into a coordinated operating model that delivers reliable services, high-quality and well-governed data, and a successful migration. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating priorities for the enterprise data environment, balancing current service needs with modernization and migration objectives.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team across data engineering, business analysis, data validation and quality, and data governance; clarify accountability, establish expectations, and support professional growth.
* Maintain the reliability, availability, performance, security, and supportability of the existing enterprise data warehouse and its critical data pipelines.
* Lead the planning and execution of the enterprise data warehouse migration to a cloud-based environment, including scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks, resourcing, milestones, and business readiness.
* Direct modernization of data architecture, platforms, pipelines, processes, and controls to improve scalability, automation, resilience, maintainability, and cost effectiveness.
* Establish a practical transition strategy that protects business continuity, manages legacy and cloud coexistence, and ensures migrated workloads and data meet agreed operational and business requirements.
* Ensure migration outcomes are validated through appropriate testing, reconciliation, data-quality controls, business acceptance, and production-readiness reviews.
* Set expectations for engineering standards and practices, including architecture, automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, testing, observability, incident response, and documentation.
* Establish and oversee data-quality practices that monitor completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and schema conformance across source, pipeline, and warehouse data.
* Lead data governance practices that support clear ownership, stewardship, definitions, metadata, lineage, access controls, classification, retention, and responsible use of enterprise data.
* Build trusted relationships with business leaders, GM Canada stakeholders, enterprise data consumers, technology partners, security and risk teams, and global platform organizations.
* Translate business priorities into a sequenced and measurable data roadmap, ensuring stakeholder needs and downstream impacts are represented in decisions.
* Oversee requirements management, backlog priorities, sprint and release planning, delivery tracking, risk and issue management, and cross-team dependencies.
* Establish clear measures of success for platform health, service reliability, migration progress, data quality, governance, delivery outcomes, and customer or business impact.
* Ensure operational procedures, support models, escalation paths, service expectations, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place for both legacy and cloud environments.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and data-informed decision-making across the team.
* Guide the development of secure, trusted, discoverable, and well-documented data foundations that can support analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise-wide AI adoption.
Communicate progress, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders and delivery partners.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant progressive experience leading enterprise data, data engineering, data platforms, technology modernization, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex, enterprise-scale data or technology initiatives.
* Experience operating and modernizing enterprise data warehouses and production data platforms, preferably including Oracle-based environments.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale data platform or warehouse migrations, from assessment and planning through implementation, validation, and operational transition.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, data integration, ETL/ELT, cloud data platforms, data quality, and enterprise data operations.
* Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, quality, reliability, and operational practices for business-critical data environments.
* Ability to set strategic direction while maintaining sufficient technical depth to evaluate architecture, delivery approaches, risks, and trade-offs.
* Strong business and financial judgment, with the ability to prioritize work and resources against enterprise outcomes and operational needs.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills, including the ability to align senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong change leadership skills and the ability to guide teams and stakeholders through complex modernization while sustaining current operations.
* Experience with Agile or iterative delivery models, portfolio or roadmap planning, and management of complex cross-functional dependencies.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and risk-management capabilities.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience leading an on-premises Oracle data warehouse migration to Azure, Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Synapse, or equivalent enterprise data and lakehouse technologies.
* Familiarity with cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data pipeline automation, and cloud operations.
* Experience establishing data observability, automated data-quality controls, reconciliation practices, and operational scorecards.
* Experience leading data governance and stewardship programs, including cataloging, lineage, classification, data ownership, and access management.
* Experience modernizing data platforms and operating models to support advanced analytics, machine learning, or enterprise AI use cases.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed, regulated, or security-sensitive enterprise environment.
Familiarity with enterprise tools and practices for Agile delivery, service management, documentation, and operational monitoring.

Title: Senior Escalation Manager
Description:
Crusoe is on a mission
*to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*
. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.
  
  
We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.
  
  
We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.
  
  
If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.
  
  
**About the Role:**
Crusoe Cloud runs some of the most demanding AI workloads in the world on large-scale GPU infrastructure. When something goes wrong for a customer, the path from first report to root cause often crosses several teams: Support Engineering, Product Engineering, SRE, Networking, Storage, and Data Center Operations. As Escalation Manager, you'll own that path.
  
  
Reporting to the Director, Customer Support Engineering, within Cloud Go-To-Market, you'll be the bridge between Customer Support and Engineering. You'll track every escalation and customer-impacting incident from start to finish, make sure the right engineers are engaged and moving, and keep customers and stakeholders informed. Then you'll look across all of it to find the patterns, turn them into supportability requests the Product team can act on, and drive the escalation rate down over time.
  
  
You'll work side by side with the Senior Manager, Customer Support, who leads and develops the Support Engineering team. They build the team's technical depth; you make sure the path from Support to Engineering is fast, visible, and needed less often. Together, you'll help support engineers take more ownership of their cases, both before and after they escalate.
  
  
**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Define and maintain escalation criteria, severity definitions, and handoff standards so support engineers know when to escalate, how to escalate, and what an escalation-ready case looks like
* Build and publish reporting on escalation volume and rate, time to engage, time to resolve, aging, and top drivers by product area and customer, for Support, Engineering, and Product leadership to use in their decisions
* Improve the tooling and workflows between the support platform and engineering trackers, such as Zendesk and Jira, so escalations move faster with less manual work
* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of every escalation from Support to Engineering: intake, triage, routing, follow-through, and closure
* Keep a single source of truth for all active escalations and customer-impacting incidents, each with a clear owner, next step, and ETA, so nothing ages without someone noticing
* Own the supportability backlog with Product, track requests through to delivery, and close the loop with the support team on what shipped
* Own escalation rate as a core KPI, set reduction targets with the Director, and lead the initiatives that bring escalation rate and time to resolve down quarter over quarter
* Act as the primary bridge between Support Engineers and Engineering teams, unblocking stalled issues and escalating further when needed
* Run recurring escalation reviews with Engineering to keep aging issues moving
* Join incident response for customer-impacting events: coordinate support-side communication, track affected customers, and make sure follow-ups land after resolution
* Give clear, timely status updates to customers, account teams, and leadership on high-severity and high-visibility issues
* File, prioritize, and advocate for supportability requests with Product, including better logging, diagnostics, observability, error messages, self-service tooling, and internal admin capabilities that let Support resolve issues without Engineering
* Bring the customer's voice into product planning with data, not anecdotes
* Review escalations regularly to identify recurring issues, product gaps, knowledge gaps, and process breakdowns
* Feed findings into postmortems, runbooks, and knowledge base articles, and partner with the Senior Manager, Customer Support on training that closes the gaps the escalation data reveals
* Coach support engineers to troubleshoot further, own cases end to end, and actively drive their escalations instead of handing them off

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 5+ years in technical support, support engineering, escalation management, incident management, or SRE/operations in a cloud, infrastructure, or SaaS environment
* 2+ years owning escalations or incidents that span multiple engineering teams
* A solid technical foundation in cloud infrastructure, including Linux, networking, virtualization, and Kubernetes: enough to read logs, follow a technical investigation, and hold your own with engineers
* A track record of reducing escalation volume or resolution time through process, tooling, or product changes
* Comfort with data: building dashboards and reports (SQL, Looker, Tableau, Sheets, or similar) and turning them into clear recommendations
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Zendesk, Jira or incident.io, and Slack
* Calm, clear communication under pressure, in writing and live, with customers, engineers, and executives
* The ability to influence without authority and hold cross-functional teams to their commitments
* Experience in a fast-paced organization going through rapid growth

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with GPU compute, HPC, InfiniBand or RoCE networking, or AI/ML training and inference infrastructure
* A background as a support engineer or SRE before moving into escalation management
* Experience standing up an escalation or problem management function from scratch
* Scripting or automation skills (Python, Bash) to streamline workflows
* ITIL or other incident and problem management certification

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**
Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $145,000 - $175,000 base + bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Title: Cybersecurity Operations Manager
Description:
**Description**
Are you a cybersecurity leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys solving complex security challenges? Join us as a
**Manager, Cybersecurity Operations**
and lead security operations, incident response, and continuous improvement initiatives that help protect our business and Team Members every day.
  
  
**Position:**
Cybersecurity Operations Manager
  
  
**Job Overview**
This role provides operational leadership across cybersecurity monitoring, incident triage, investigation coordination, vulnerability management, remediation tracking, vendor coordination, security reporting, and operational follow-up. The role manages cybersecurity analysts, supports team coverage and cross-training, and works with IT teams, vendors, and external partners to resolve security issues and drive remediation actions.
  
  
The role is also accountable for ensuring incidents are investigated, documented, contained, remediated, and followed through to closure, while maintaining ownership of the incident response plan, escalation paths, operational playbooks, and regular incident response tabletop exercises.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Lead day-to-day cybersecurity operations, including security monitoring, incident triage, investigation coordination, vulnerability management, remediation tracking, and operational follow-up.
* Act as the primary internal operational contact for managed security service providers and security vendors, including escalation review, service quality, reporting, and improvement follow-up.
* Manage, coach, and develop cybersecurity analysts, including work prioritization, performance management, career development, and quality of delivery.
* Build appropriate team coverage, cross-training, and documentation to reduce dependency on individual team members.
* Ensure security incidents are appropriately investigated, documented, contained, remediated, and followed through to closure.
* Own and maintain the incident response plan, escalation paths, operational playbooks, and regular incident response tabletop exercises.
* Make day-to-day operational decisions within established security processes and escalate material risks, exceptions, vendor concerns, or issues requiring leadership direction.
* Prioritize operational activities, remediation efforts, and team capacity based on risk, business impact, service requirements, and available resources.
* Drive continuous improvement of incident response processes, operational procedures, monitoring practices, and security controls.
* Support cybersecurity initiatives where operational input, testing, implementation support, or transition into ongoing support is required.
* Provide security input into relevant technology and operational changes, and support other areas of IT and the business based on operational demand.
* Work with IT teams, vendors, and external partners to resolve security issues, drive remediation actions, and clarify ownership and timelines.
* Use operational metrics and trends to identify improvement opportunities and report on security performance.
* Support security assurance, audit, compliance, and third-party security assessment activities as needed.

**Health And Safety**

* Promotes and endorses Safety Vision “Safety is our way of life”.
* Observes and support Longo’s Safe Work guidelines and other safe work practices.
* Role models the importance of health and safety by always working safely, and calls out and addressed and safety issues.
* Recognizes risks which may pose a danger to Team Members and customers and resolves such issues (where possible) or modifies work, mitigating the risk to Team Member/customer until resolution can be sourced and implemented (i.e. Longo’s Call Center Harassment/Violence Reference Guide)
* Ensures all pre-use checks (where applicable) are conducted and all equipment is maintained to provide for safe operation by Team Members.
* Ensures that TMs are trained to safely carry out their work in the department, and ensures that all work is safely carried out by Team Members.

**Key Area Of Responsibility**

* Partner with IT, Infrastructure, Application Support, Service Desk, vendors, and external partners to address cybersecurity issues and remediation activities.
* Provide security input into technology changes and operational initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, security assurance, and third-party security assessment activities.
* Escalate material risks, operational issues, exceptions, vendor concerns, or decisions requiring leadership direction, and act as a point of escalation for urgent cybersecurity issues outside regular business hours when required.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong operational leadership, with the ability to prioritize effectively, make sound decisions, and maintain accountability across the team.
* Comfortable working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, unexpected issues, and competing deadlines.
* Calm, structured, and solution-focused during incidents, escalations, and high-pressure situations.
* Able to take ownership, make practical recommendations, and drive issues through to resolution.
* Effective at coaching team members while maintaining high standards for quality, documentation, and follow-through.
* Able to operate effectively with incomplete information or unclear ownership, using sound judgement and escalating when leadership direction is required.
* Able to communicate security risks, operational priorities, progress, and decisions clearly to technical teams, vendors, and leadership.

**Required**
**Knowledge, Skills & Credentials:**

* 6 to 8 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, IT infrastructure, or a related technical field.
* 1 to 3 years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing cybersecurity analysts, technical teams, or security workstreams.
* Experience with security monitoring, incident triage, incident response, vulnerability management, or security operations.
* Experience overseeing or working within an MSSP-supported security operations model, including alert escalation, incident coordination, and service performance management.
* Experience working with managed security service providers, security vendors, or external security partners.
* Familiarity with enterprise security technologies across endpoint security, identity and access management, network segmentation, vulnerability management, email security, network security, cloud security, or security service management.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks or compliance requirements such as PCI-DSS, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or similar.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, reporting, and documentation skills.
* Experience maintaining or supporting incident response plans, escalation procedures, playbooks, and tabletop exercises.

**Preferred / Asset**

* Experience supporting third-party security assessments, vendor security reviews, or remediation tracking.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, control validation, or remediation activities.
* Experience developing operational metrics, dashboards, KPIs, KRIs, or management reporting.
* Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Security+, GCIH, GCIA, or equivalent.
* ITIL, PMP, Scrum, or formal project management experience.

**Working Conditions**

* Full-time, permanent role.
* Fast-paced operational environment with shifting priorities, unexpected issues, and competing deadlines.
* Role may require participation in incident response, escalations, vendor coordination, and time-sensitive remediation activities.
* Requires regular communication with technical teams, vendors, external partners, and leadership.
* Requires availability to participate in an on-call or escalation rotation and act as a point of escalation for urgent cybersecurity issues outside regular business hours when required.

Title: Director, Enterprise Service Delivery (4 Days Onsite- Brentwood, TN)
Lead Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Business Introduction**
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Digital & Tech Command Centre operates 24x7x365 to protect GSK’s critical sites, applications and services. Disruption or degradation to these directly impacts patient supply, research and colleague productivity.
  
  
This role owns and leads the end-to-end response to Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents. In collaboration with AI-enabled monitoring, detection and triage capabilities, the role directs resolver
  
  
teams and subject matter experts from across Tech towards the fastest possible restoration of service, while providing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate communication to end users, senior stakeholders and
  
  
executive leadership. The role also assesses incidents for crisis potential, secures the quality of the incident record for downstream Problem Management, and drives continuous improvement in prevention, detection and response - including the adoption of AI and automation to shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore. As a more experienced member of the Major Incident Manager team, the role additionally acts as an escalation point within the team, to support less experienced colleagues, as well as to field senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information. Additionally, the role supports management of the shift rota, supports the personal
  
  
development of Major Incident Managers through structured feedback and mentoring and leads service-related objectives such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
**Major Incident Response & Command**

* Own the end-to-end management of Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents, from detection through to confirmed service restoration, acting as the single point of control for the duration of the incident.
* Rapidly establish impact, urgency and scope, confirm correct prioritisation, and drive immediate engagement of the right resolver teams, subject matter experts and vendors.
* Lead technical bridges with authority, keeping activity focused on restoration, controlling scope, and ensuring hypotheses are tested and eliminated systematically.
* Drive and record decisions under pressure – balancing speed of restoration against risk.
* Drive resolution against agreed major incident targets, escalating promptly where progress stalls or
* additional authority, resource or vendor commitment is required.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Own incident communications, producing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate updates, including for senior leaders, at agreed intervals.
* Translate complex technical detail into clear business impact language, setting realistic expectations on restoration.
* Act as an escalation point for senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information, coordinating accurate, consistent responses across resolver teams and owning follow-up through to closure.

**Incident Assessment, Categorisation & Escalation**

* Continuously assess live incidents for impact, applying criteria to determine appropriate handling.
* Trigger escalation routes without delay, providing the initial situational assessment.
* Maintain awareness of site criticality, business-critical periods and service dependencies so that escalation decisions reflect true business risk.

**Service Quality, Data & Continuous Improvement**

* Secure the quality, completeness and accuracy of the incident record – timeline, impact, actions taken and causal indicators – so that Problem Management can be effective.
* Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews, ensuring findings, follow-up actions and preventative measures are captured, owned and tracked to closure.
* Identify recurring themes, fragile services and gaps in monitoring, alerting, knowledge or runbooks, and feed these into improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to the development and adoption of AI, automation and data-driven tooling that shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore.
* Drive continual improvements into process and playbooks.
* Lead defined service-related objectives, such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives, owning them end to end and tracking measurable improvement.

**Shift Operations & Readiness**

* Operate as part of a 24x7x365 shift pattern, including public holiday and on-call working as required.
* Support management of the shift rota, helping to ensure balanced, compliant 24x7x365 cover across regions, and flagging gaps, fatigue and coverage risks to the Senior Major Incident Manager.
* Deliver rigorous shift handovers so that live incidents, risks and pending actions transfer seamlessly with no loss of context or momentum.
* Maintain personal and team readiness through participation in recovery tests, crisis simulations and major incident rehearsals.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Acts as an escalation point within the team, providing support to less experienced colleagues.
* Support the personal development of Major Incident Managers, including through structured feedback sessions and mentoring, helping to raise the capability, consistency and resilience of the MIM
* community.
* Approach and Collaboration
* Bring a team-first collaborative mindset and approach, to ensure effective cross-functional working.

Why You?
  
  
**Basic Qualification**
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, IT or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years in IT service operations within a large, complex, global organisation, including time in a Major Incident Management role.
* ITIL v4 certification is required.
* Experience with leading P1 incidents end to end, directing multiple technical teams and third parties concurrently.
* Experience communicating during live incidents to a range of audiences, including senior leaders, under time pressure.
* Experience working to defined service levels and KPIs, with evidence of improving incident response performance.
* Experience of 24x7 shift-based and on-call working, including structured handover.
* Experience of enterprise ITSM tooling (ServiceNow preferred) and
* monitoring/alerting platforms.
* Experience in a regulated industry (pharmaceutical, life sciences, financial services or similar) desirable

**Preferred Qualification**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus
  
  

* Composure and personal authority under pressure, with the ability to lead specialists who do not report to the role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, moving fluently between technical detail and business impact.
* Strong facilitation and questioning skills to keep a bridge focused and eliminate hypotheses systematically.
* Sound judgement in balancing speed of restoration against risk.
* Analytical mindset, interpreting service data and operational metrics to inform improvement.
* Strong documentation and process-design capability.
* Fluency in written and spoken English
